steps.title: Welcome to AgentPlaza
steps.body: AgentPlaza runs your AI agents on machines you own, each in its own isolated VM, under one hub that records what they do.

steps.title: Choose a look
steps.body: Loom is warm paper with mono labels and ink for actions. Graphite is cool neutrals with cobalt. Both come in light and dark, and you can change the look any time in Appearance.

steps.title: Your hub
steps.body: This console is connected to one hub. Check that it is the hub you meant.

steps.title: Dependencies
steps.body: The plaza's requirements: the services beside the app, their ports free, and a hypervisor for the agents' VMs. Nothing is installed here: no Docker or database is needed, and anything not ready says what to do.

steps.title: Model keys
steps.body: Agents think with model providers. Each provider needs an API key, kept in the vault and never shown again.

steps.title: Checks
steps.body: The basics of the plaza. Anything not ready can be fixed on the Setup screen.

deps.not_ready: Fix what is missing, then check again, or skip for now.
deps.web_lead: The browser cannot install anything on the host. For each missing one, run its command on the host:
deps.web_desktop: Or open the AgentPlaza desktop app on that machine and check them there.
deps.web_host: No Docker or database is needed: the hub keeps its state in SQLite. Check the rest with
deps.web_services: Start AgentPlaza on the host (desktop app: Start locally)
deps.web_hypervisor: Turn on virtualization in the firmware: agents run in VMs
deps.web_weft: Weft runs inside the hub: restarting the hub starts it

look.loom_about: Warm paper, mono capital labels, ink for actions
look.graphite_about: Cool neutrals, sans labels, cobalt for actions

steps.title: Overview
steps.body: The plaza at a glance: the hub and node status, how many agents are working, and a live feed of what is happening.

steps.title: Agents
steps.body: Your agents. Each works on the project its task gives it; one with none waits and uses nothing. Open one for its details, its model and its tools.

steps.title: Floor
steps.body: A 3D view of your machines and agents. Click a machine to enter it.

steps.title: Projects and tasks
steps.body: Start a project in a conversation with the orchestrator (New project, in the switcher at the top): it drafts the tasks and the budget, and you start it. The switcher shows one project, or all of them.

steps.title: Approvals
steps.body: Requests waiting for you: an agent asking to spend, act or change something. Approve or refuse each one.

steps.title: Models and usage
steps.body: Your model keys, the models agents use, and what they spend. Usage shows the cost by agent and day.

steps.title: Setup
steps.body: Checks the plaza again, and replays this tour or the setup wizard whenever you like.

setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: The checks behind this console, and the guided setup and tour again.
